title: LookObjects
description: Data file content/look/objects.json: how the core's objects (trees, bushes, berries, water sources, stones ...) are drawn on the island in the main game. Each object type maps to one simple shape of the look prototype (D569) in palette colours; size and turn vary per object, derived from its id (same picture at every start). A type without an entry gets the calm neutral fallback marker and is logged once. Presentation only, not part of the hash.

outline.description: Whether objects get the ink outline pass.

outline_width_m.description: Width of the ink outline hull in metres.

ground_tolerance_m.description: How far (metres) the underside of an object lying on the ground (align ground or ground_uphill) may float above or sink below the drawn ground within its footprint (D576, TL #19553); the tests hold every object of the start island to it. Placeholder value.

ObjectLookShape.description: Shape builder of the game (simple low-poly meshes of the look prototype); none draws nothing (for example sea water, the sea is drawn already).

ObjectLookFallback.description: Calm neutral marker for object types without an entry.

colors.description: Palette colour ids (content/look/palette.json) by role: 0 main (crown, body, stone, water, cap, fruit), 1 second (trunk, berries, rim, stem, bloom, cut end, heads), 2 third (second crown layer, fruit on a tree). A shape with more roles than colours repeats them from the start.

size_m.description: Size factor (1 = the shape's base size).

ObjectVisual.description: Shape and colours for one or more object types.

types.description: Object type ids (content/objects) drawn this way.

colors.description: Palette colour ids (content/look/palette.json) by role: 0 main (crown, body, stone, water, cap, fruit), 1 second (trunk, berries, rim, stem, bloom, cut end, heads), 2 third (second crown layer, fruit on a tree). A shape with more roles than colours repeats them from the start.

size_m.description: Size factor (1 = the shape's base size).

size_jitter.description: Size varies per object by up to this share either way (calm variety).

lift_m.description: Height above the ground in metres (negative sinks it in a little).

footprint_m.description: Radius in metres (at size factor 1) over which the object meets the ground: rest lowest/highest samples it, align ground fits the slope to it (for a long object: half its length along its local x axis).

footprint_width_m.description: Half width in metres (at size factor 1) of an elongated footprint across its local x axis (a log); absent = round (footprint_m).

ObjectLookRest.description: Which ground height an upright object stands on: centre (the ground under its position), lowest or highest ground within its footprint. Objects that lie on the ground (align ground, ground_uphill) follow the slope instead and ignore it.

ObjectLookAlign.description: How an object meets the ground (D576): upright stands straight up on its rest height (trees, bushes, plants); ground lies on the ground and follows its slope (logs, stones), turned from its id towards the turn that fits the ground best; ground_uphill lies on the ground like ground with its local +x side facing uphill (a spring pool with its stones at the uphill side).
